extensions.question: For every schema_version transition, does a migration exist, is it idempotent, and does running it twice leave the artifact unchanged?

negative_controls.description: Registry missing 2->3 must fail coverage; conforming registry must stay green.
always-mutate apply_mode must fail idempotence; conforming registry must stay green.
always-noop apply_mode must fail first-apply-progress; conforming registry must stay green.
DROP policy on unparseable input must fail quarantine-no-drop; conforming registry must stay green.
schema_version-only transform must fail transformation-obligation; conforming registry must stay green.
